task_objective: Process an expert-review finding into a classified failure mode, prevention mechanism and reviewed improvement path.

text_first_baseline.input_summary: Broad text bundle from review comments, implementation notes, process notes and improvement ideas.

gates: raw opinion must be classified before canonical update
prevention mechanism must map to a failure mode
improvement must enter as reviewed proposal
expert review remains design evidence unless independently validated

expected.transition_boundary: review finding may create a prevention proposal but may not directly mutate canonical method or graph truth
expected.evidence_boundary: expert review may support method improvement proposals; it is not independent validation by itself

limitations: Fixture seed reuses public synthetic method-inspection data.
Execution scoring is stored separately in the execution record.
Reviewer scoring is non-independent until an external or separated reviewer is added.
